alt: Poster: Sensex 83,021.75 (+1.21%) and Nifty 50 25,514.30 (+1.14%) on 19 Nov 2026; Nifty Auto +4.40%, Nifty IT -1.10%
text:
Indian benchmarks rallied over 1% on Thursday, with autos leading and IT the lone sectoral laggard.

• The Sensex closed at 83,021.75, up 989.94 points (1.21%), and the Nifty 50 at 25,514.30, up 286.35 points (1.14%), per closing reports from Kotak Neo, Liquide and ETV Bharat.
• Nifty Auto rose 4.40%, Nifty Consumer Durables 3.64% and Nifty FMCG 2.09%, while Nifty IT fell 1.10%, per Kotak Neo and Liquide sector data.
• Both reports cite easing commodity prices (copper and aluminium) and continued foreign inflows among the reasons for the move.
• Kotak Neo reports the combined BSE market capitalisation touched a record Rs 512 lakh crore.

Our view: a rally led by input-cost-sensitive sectors suggests markets are reacting to softer commodity prices, while the fall in IT shows that leadership remains selective. One session is a small sample, and these moves can reverse. This is an interpretation of the data, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: do you see falling input costs as a durable driver for autos and consumer sectors, or mainly a one-session reaction?
